def transform(grid):
    # Overlay the four stacked 3-row panels; earlier nonzero marks take priority.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    n = h // 4
    return [[next((grid[r + k*n][c] for k in range(4) if grid[r + k*n][c] != 0), 0)
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
